doors.why: V2: Neon Boulevard Recovery Bay (cyan cross)
V2: Neon Boulevard shop (pink bag sign)

t: NEONIS STARPORT - Deck 7. Mind the landing ring while ships are docking.
A holo-ad loops: a glowing jellyfish Alienmon drifts by. 'Stay charged. Stay bright. Neonis.'
GLITCH HUNT: static-y Alienmon flicker between the cabinets after dark. Bring Stasis Pods!
Dock tech: Ships land on that orange ring. Stand clear unless you like being flattened.
Dock tech: The whole deck floats on Volt power. If the lights flicker, hold onto something.
Courier: Deliveries are faster across the catwalks. Faster still if your Alienmon can fly.
Raver: First time on Neonis? The city never sleeps. Neither do I, apparently.
Port guard: Helix freighters docked here last week. Paperwork was clean. Too clean, if you ask me.
Signal researcher: Every Relay Tower picks up the same pulse, every eight seconds. Spooky, right?
Traveller: The dome with the cross is the Recovery Bay. It heals your whole team for free. Use it!
Mom: My son wants to be a DJ like Static. I told him to finish his homework first.
Raver: The whole city hums with Volt energy. Feel it? That buzz in your teeth?
Coder: Every sign in Neonis runs on Alienmon power. They get paid in snacks. Good snacks.
Courier: The Arcade District is east. Trainers there love a surprise battle.
Tourist: Volt types hate ground moves. Remember that before you climb Voltspire.
Street vendor: Neon noodles! You glow for an hour after eating. Totally safe. Mostly.
Archivist: Signal Shards are said to resonate with each other. Collect them and listen closely.
Suspicious man: Helix? Never heard of it. I just... like dark uniforms. Move along.
Gamer: High score on Star Saucer 3! ...Okay, second highest. A Coder beat me with a macro.
Repair coder: Glitchy Alienmon hide in the static. A weakened one is easier to catch in a Stasis Pod.
Courier: Trainers battle you if you walk into their line of sight. Fight, or sneak around them.
Dish tech: These antennas relay DJ Static's show to the whole system. Someone keeps hijacking channel 9.
Hiker: The glowing grass is full of wild Alienmon. Keep a few Stasis Pods handy.
Radio fan: DJ Static picked up a signal coming from the Starfall Rift. It repeats every 8 seconds.
Raver: Voltspire is just east. Static's apprentices guard the first floor. They're loud. Really loud.
Stage guard: Welcome to Voltspire! The Keeper waits at the top. Heal up before you climb.
Sound tech: Feel that bass? That's the reactor below us. Static tunes it like an instrument.
Nurse: Welcome to the Neonis Recovery Bay! Step up to the counter and we'll recharge your team.
Raver: Three battles in a row at the Arcade. My Alienmon needed a nap. So did I.
Clerk: Welcome to the Neonis Shop! Stasis Pods, potions, all the essentials.
Shopper: Stock up before Voltspire. Static's team hits hard and fast.

notes: Neonis: the Recovery Bay and Shop interiors both link to the Starport (062), where the player lands. Neon Boulevard (063) also has a bay front and a shop front drawn; they are left blocked/unlisted and could take extra interiors later. Arcade District (066) is a 'field' but no grass or weeds are drawn (all paving and arcade plazas), so it has no tall grass. Routes 067/068 use the glowing blue sparkle beds as tall grass. Voltspire 1F: 2 apprentices flank the two side corridors at rows 10-11; 2F gets 1 auto trainer; DJ Static stands in front of the broadcast terminal at 071 (8,4) and is challenged from (8,5).
